title: Agentic commerce: trust, consent, security, and interoperability
discussion_signal: Visa frames AI-initiated payments around trust, consent, security, and interoperability, while audience discussion emphasizes permissioning, authentication, auditability, and liability. The signal makes control and reversibility central consumer-power questions as software acts on a person’s behalf.
linked_research_question: What consent, control, liability, and recourse mechanisms preserve consumer power when AI agents initiate transactions?
limits: The post does not demonstrate how disputed or unauthorized transactions are resolved
